nodes.description: Storage.State _state: core proxy storage holding balances, accounts, epochs, candidates, and provider references
Storage.State13 _state13 (DIP-13): couponUnderlyingByAccount mapping, total couponUnderlying, and cached price
Storage.State16 _state16 (DIP-16): legacyOracle address and epochStartForSushiswapPool switch epoch
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for minting rewards, coupon accounting, and governance votes
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time source driving epoch calculation and coupon redemption penalty
Implementation.advance() external incentivized: advances epoch/total bonded, runs regulator and market steps, then mints an incentive
modifier incentivized: after the guarded body it queries Chainlink ETH/gas feeds and mints DSD to msg.sender as a reward
Upgradeable.upgradeTo(address) internal: sets the proxy implementation slot then delegatecalls initialize() on the new implementation
Govern.commit(address) external: checks quorum/approval and calls upgradeTo on the winning candidate
Govern.emergencyCommit(address) external: super-majority path that calls upgradeTo without a normal timelock
Bonding.deposit(uint256) external: pulls DSD from the caller into staged balance
Bonding.bond(uint256) external: converts staged DSD into bonded DSDS using totalSupply/totalBonded ratio
Bonding.withdraw(uint256) external: returns staged DSD to a frozen/locked account
Bonding.unbond(uint256) external: converts bonded DSDS back into staged DSD
Bonding.unbondUnderlying(uint256) external: unbonds based on underlying DSD value
Market.purchaseCoupons(uint256) external: burns DSD debt to receive epoch coupons split into expirable and underlying halves
Market.redeemCoupons(uint256,uint256,uint256) external: redeems coupon underlying during expansion, applying a penalty burn
Market.transferCoupons(address,address,uint256,uint256) external: moves coupon balances with allowance checks
Market.migrateCoupons(uint256) external: migrates legacy coupon balances to the DIP-13 underlying accounting
Implementation.initialize() public initializer: configures the new oracle/pool addresses and mints 2000 DSD to three hardcoded accounts
Comptroller.mintToAccount(address,uint256) internal: mints DSD and optionally increases protocol debt
Comptroller.burnFromAccount(address,uint256) internal: pulls DSD from an account and burns it against protocol debt
Comptroller.redeemToAccount(address,uint256,uint256) internal: mints redeemable DSD and transfers coupon payouts
Govern.vote(address,Candidate.Vote) external: records bonded stake votes on a nominated implementation candidate
delegatecall inside upgradeTo executes candidate code with the proxy's storage and balance context
External calls to Chainlink AggregatorV3Interface.latestRoundData() used for ETH price and fast gas price in the incentive calculation
External IDollar (ERC20) mint/burn/transfer/transferFrom calls made against a state-configured token address
uint256 value parameter shared by Bonding deposit/withdraw/bond/unbond/unbondUnderlying
uint256 amount parameter of Market.purchaseCoupons
address newImplementation parameter of Upgradeable.upgradeTo
startGas local in modifier incentivized used to measure gas spent by the guarded body

edges.reason: msg.sender triggers advance() and the incentive is paid back to the caller
incentive mint recipient is msg.sender inside the modifier
block.timestamp is emitted in Advance and influences the epoch used for the incentive
advance() records block.timestamp and epoch advancement depends on blockTimestamp()
couponRedemptionPenalty derives timeIntoEpoch from block.timestamp % period, making the penalty miner-influenceable
advance() is guarded by the incentivized modifier which runs post-body
the modifier performs external Chainlink latestRoundData queries after state changes
the modifier mints the computed advance reward through mintToAccount
mint recipient address is the caller msg.sender
a successful commit() calls upgradeTo() on the winning candidate address
emergencyCommit() with super majority also drives upgradeTo()
upgradeTo delegates execution to newImplementation via delegatecall
delegatecalled candidate code runs against _state storage and can overwrite protocol balances
delegatecalled code can overwrite DIP-13 storage _state13
delegatecalled code can overwrite DIP-16 storage _state16
the externally supplied candidate address becomes the delegatecall target in upgradeTo
mintToAccount calls external dollar().mint on the configured token
burnFromAccount calls external dollar().transferFrom and burn
redeemToAccount calls external dollar().mint and transfer
purchaseCoupons burns the DSD amount from the caller through burnFromAccount
purchaseCoupons credits coupons and underlying to msg.sender
redeemCoupons pays the caller out via redeemToAccount
migrateCoupons moves msg.sender coupon balances into DIP-13 accounting
bond() writes bonded balance and totals into _state
withdraw() decrements staged balance in _state
unbond() updates balance and bonded totals in _state
unbondUnderlying() updates balances in _state
deposit() increases staged balance in _state
initialize() mints initial balances to hardcoded accounts via mintToAccount
user-supplied value is multiplied by totalSupply/totalBonded to compute the DSDS minted in bond()
user-supplied amount drives the coupon premium add/div arithmetic in purchaseCoupons
startGas local feeds the gas accounting consumed after the external Chainlink price queries
commit caller msg.sender is recorded in the Commit event
transferCoupons checks msg.sender against the coupon allowance of the sender
vote() records msg.sender bonded stake against a candidate
emergencyCommit caller identity is recorded in the Commit event
purchaseCoupons pulls DSD from msg.sender via burnFromAccount

normalization_plan.reason: the uint256 value parameter only feeds the bond/unbond ratio arithmetic and has no standalone semantic role
the uint256 amount parameter is only consumed by the coupon purchase arithmetic
the newImplementation parameter is only consumed as the delegatecall target inside upgradeTo
the startGas local only exists to size the incentive after the Chainlink price query
